basic_info.description: huge price reduction and other incentives provided829 Folsom is a boutique building in the heart of the vibrant Yerba Buena District. This serene, extremely private courtyard-facing unit features a large bedroom, a versatile den area, floor-to-ceiling windows, bamboo flooring, a custom kitchen with stainless steel appliances, in-unit laundry, and secured garage parking for one vehicle. Built to the highest standards, this elegant building continues to be a gold standard in modern construction. Building features include a 24/7 lobby attendant, package management, a rooftop with sweeping views of downtown San Francisco, and a reservable entertainment area. Perfectly situated near the city's best entertainment, museums, dining, and transit options, including the new T Muni line just a half-block away. Welcome home to 829 Folsom, where everything will be at your fingertips.
